text_en: In the eighteenth year of King Jehoshaphat of Judah, Jehoram son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria; he reigned twelve years.
text_cn: 犹大王约沙法特十八年，阿哈布的儿子耶曷兰在撒玛黎雅登极作以色列王，在位凡十二年。

text_en: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , though not like his father and mother, for he removed the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
text_cn: 他行了上主视为恶的事，不过还不像他的父亲和母亲那样坏，因为他除去了他父亲所立的巴耳神柱，

text_en: Nevertheless he clung to the sin of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he caused Israel to commit; he did not depart from it.
text_cn: 只是对乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕使以色列陷于罪过的事，仍恋恋不舍，从未脱离。

text_en: Now King Mesha of Moab was a sheep breeder, who used to deliver to the king of Israel one hundred thousand lambs, and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.
text_cn: 摩阿布王默沙原是一个以畜牧为业的人，他经常以十万只羔羊和十万只公山羊毛，向以色列王进贡；

text_en: But when Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
text_cn: 但在阿哈布死后，摩阿布王便背叛了以色列王。

text_en: So King Jehoram marched out of Samaria at that time and mustered all Israel.
text_cn: 那时，耶曷兰王从撒玛黎雅出来，检阅全以色列人，

text_en: As he went he sent word to King Jehoshaphat of Judah, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me; will you go with me to battle against Moab? ” He answered, “I will; I am with you, my people are your people, my horses are your horses. ”
text_cn: 以后派使者去见犹大王约沙法特说：“摩阿布王背叛了我，你愿意同我一起去攻打摩阿布吗？”约沙法特说：“愿意去；你怎样，我也怎样；我的人民就如同是你的人民，我的马就如同是你的马。”

text_en: Then he asked, “By which way shall we march? ” Jehoram answered, “By the way of the wilderness of Edom. ”
text_cn: 约沙法特接着问说：“我们从那条路上去？”耶曷兰答说：“从厄东旷野那条路。”

text_en: So the king of Israel, the king of Judah, and the king of Edom set out; and when they had made a roundabout march of seven days, there was no water for the army or for the animals that were with them.
text_cn: 于是以色列王、犹大王和厄东王出发，绕道而行，七天以后，军队和随行的一大队牲畜没有水喝。

text_en: Then the king of Israel said, “Alas! The Lord has summoned us, three kings, only to be handed over to Moab. ”
text_cn: 以色列王说：“哎！上主召集这三个王子，原是将他们交在摩阿布手中啊！”

text_en: But Jehoshaphat said, “Is there no prophet of the Lord here, through whom we may inquire of the Lord ? ” Then one of the servants of the king of Israel answered, “Elisha son of Shaphat, who used to pour water on the hands of Elijah, is here. ”
text_cn: 约沙法特问说：“这里有没有一位上主的先知，我们可以托他求问上主？”以色列王的一个臣仆回答说：“这里有沙法特的儿子厄里叟，就是常在厄里亚手上倒水的那一位。”

text_en: Jehoshaphat said, “The word of the Lord is with him. ” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
text_cn: 约沙法特说：“他必有上主的话。”以色列王、约沙法特和厄东王，于是一同下去见他。

text_en: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to your father’s prophets or to your mother’s. ” But the king of Israel said to him, “No; it is the Lord who has summoned us, three kings, only to be handed over to Moab. ”
text_cn: 厄里叟对以色列王说：“我和你有什么关系？你去找你父亲和你母亲的先知吧！” 以色列王说：“不要这样说！上主召集了这三个王子，原是要将他们交于摩阿布手中啊！”

text_en: Elisha said, “As the Lord of hosts lives, whom I serve, were it not that I have regard for King Jehoshaphat of Judah, I would give you neither a look nor a glance.
text_cn: 厄里叟说：“我指着我所服事的永生万军的上主起誓：我如果不是为了犹大王约沙法特的情面，我决不看你，也不睬你。

text_en: But get me a musician. ” And then, while the musician was playing, the power of the Lord came on him.
text_cn: 现在，你们给我叫一个弹琴的人来。”原来每逢乐师弹琴的时候，上主的手就临到他身上。

text_en: And he said, “Thus says the Lord , ‘I will make this wadi full of pools. ’
text_cn: 厄里叟说：“上主这样说：你们在这山谷中遍挖壕沟，

text_en: For thus says the Lord , ‘You shall see neither wind nor rain, but the wadi shall be filled with water, so that you shall drink, you, your cattle, and your animals. ’
text_cn: 因为上主这样说：你们不见风，也不见雨，这山谷中却要充满了水，使你们、你们的军队和牲畜都有水喝。

text_en: This is only a trifle in the sight of the Lord , for he will also hand Moab over to you.
text_cn: 这在上主看来还是小事，他还要将摩阿布交在你们手中，

text_en: You shall conquer every fortified city and every choice city; every good tree you shall fell, all springs of water you shall stop up, and every good piece of land you shall ruin with stones. ”
text_cn: 使你们攻破所有设防的城市，砍倒所有的好树，堵塞所有的水泉，用石头毁坏所有的良田。”

text_en: The next day, about the time of the morning offering, suddenly water began to flow from the direction of Edom, until the country was filled with water.
text_cn: 果然，早上正献祭的时候，从厄东方面来了大水，遍地满了水。

text_en: When all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, all who were able to put on armor, from the youngest to the oldest, were called out and were drawn up at the frontier.
text_cn: 全摩阿布人一听说三个王子前来进攻，就召集了所有能佩带武器的人，把守边界。

text_en: When they rose early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.
text_cn: 第二天早晨，日光照在水上，摩阿布人起来，看见对面的水红得像血，

text_en: They said, “This is blood; the kings must have fought together, and killed one another. Now then, Moab, to the spoil! ”
text_cn: 遂说：“这是血！一定是那三个王子彼此混战，互相残杀。摩阿布人，起来，前去夺取财物！”

text_en: But when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and attacked the Moabites, who fled before them; as they entered Moab they continued the attack.
text_cn: 及至他们到了以色列营地，以色列人即奋起迎敌，摩阿布人从他们面前逃走，他们就乘势追赶，击杀摩阿布人，

text_en: The cities they overturned, and on every good piece of land everyone threw a stone, until it was covered; every spring of water they stopped up, and every good tree they felled. Only at Kir-hareseth did the stone walls remain, until the slingers surrounded and attacked it.
text_cn: 破坏了他们的城市，个个用石头抛满了他们的良田，堵塞了所有的水泉，砍倒了各种好树；只剩下克尔赫勒斯城， 抛石头的人仍包围攻击那城。

text_en: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was going against him, he took with him seven hundred swordsmen to break through, opposite the king of Edom; but they could not.
text_cn: 摩阿布王见战事激烈，难以敌抗，就带领七百人，手持刀剑，企图突围，往投阿兰王，却没有成功；

text_en: Then he took his firstborn son who was to succeed him, and offered him as a burnt offering on the wall. And great wrath came upon Israel, so they withdrew from him and returned to their own land.
text_cn: 于是将那要继承自己位的长子叫来，在城墙上祭杀了，作为全燔祭。这事使天主向以色列人大发忿怒；他们便离开摩阿布王，各自回了本地。
